style: A cut-paper collage on warm paper (or warm black): flat shapes in vermilion, leaf green, ochre, pink, sky and ink, heavy Gabarito over Crimson Pro, the six disciplines as six cut-outs gathered round 'one team', services and quotes on cut card.

concept.idea: One team, many hands: a client-services agency brings different people to each job and runs them as one. Each discipline is a different cut-paper shape, and together they make one composition with 'one team' at its centre, like a cut-out collage pieced together by hand.
concept.signature: The six cut-outs start scattered and spring together into one round composition around 'one team', one after another. A button scatters and gathers them again, and a piece lifts under the pointer. Without JS or with reduced motion the collage is simply assembled.
